approved.en: US envoy Steve Witkoff met President Putin in Russia after a positive meeting with President Zelenskyy, and Russia freed American Stephen Hubbard who had been jailed for fighting for Ukraine. Ukraine carried out its first drone airlift of a wounded soldier from the front line. Russian forces continued strikes in Kyiv killing four people and injuring two, and a separate drone attack wounded five people at a hospital. NATO increased patrol plane deployments in the Black Sea in response to the heightened Russian attacks. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Ukraina gjennomførte sin første dronelufttransport av en såret soldat fra frontlinjen. Russiske styrker fortsatte angrep i Kyiv som drepte fire personer og såret to, og et separat droneangrep såret fem personer på et sykehus. NATO økte antallet patruljefly i Svartehavet som svar på de økte russiske angrepene. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

UNICEF reported that 340 children have been killed in Gaza despite a ceasefire, and food shortages are worsening as aid is cut. An Israeli minister called for settling the entire West Bank, and a far-right rival was offered a Gaza expulsion portfolio if he quits the election. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

UNICEF rapporterte at 340 barn er blitt drept i Gaza til tross for våpenhvile, og matmangel forverres etter at hjelpen er kuttet. En israelsk minister oppfordret til å bosette hele Vestbredden, og en høyreorientert rival ble tilbudt et portefølje for utvisning fra Gaza dersom han trekker seg fra valget. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. UCDP registrerte 4 335 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

There were 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Egypt’s president says Egypt would defend Saudi territory but will not attack Yemen. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

An IRGC officer was killed in the Iran-Iraq border mountains during clashes with Kurdish opposition, and Iraq has threatened a crackdown on opponents of its weapons-control and disarmament plan. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Tyrkiske styrker er fortsatt utplassert i Syria og Irak inntil grensesikkerheten er sikret, og irakiske soldater er omplassert mellom Kirkuk og Bagdad etter at IS planlegger å øke angrep i skjøre regioner. In Ruweng fresh attacks left nine dead and six wounded, while bodies arrived from the Khor Kaltan killings in Northern Bahr el Ghazal. Communal clashes continued, including 14 deaths between Warrap and Lakes communities and the arrest of a traditional chief over a Juba youth killing. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Ruweng førte friske angrep til ni døde og seks sårede, mens lik ankom fra drapene i Khor Kaltan i Nord-Bahr el Ghazal. Kommunale sammenstøt fortsatte, inkludert 14 dødsfall mellom Warrap‑ og Lakes-samfunnene og arrestasjonen av en tradisjonell høvding over et drap på en ungdom i Juba. approved.en: Ethiopian forces have installed a caretaker administration in Tigray and are moving toward the Eritrean border, while a pro-government militia says it seized the regional airport and reports Eritrean forces suffered losses there. The United States, through Secretary of State Marco Rubio, is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate, and Mekelle mayor Shishay Amare announced elections within six months to settle Western Tigray through constitutional processes. A drone strike in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73 people, and the TPLF claims to have killed 1,511 Ethiopian soldiers in recent fighting. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA, gjennom utenriksminister Marco Rubio, oppfordrer Etiopia og Eritrea til å de-eskalere, og Mekelle borgermester Shishay Amare kunngjorde valg innen seks måneder for å løse Vest-Tigray gjennom konstitusjonelle prosesser. Et droneangrep i det omstridte Abyei-området drepte minst 73 personer, og TPLF hevder å ha drept 1 511 etiopiske soldater i nylige kamper. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia announced the withdrawal of more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as its own civil war intensifies and has refused to intervene in the South West State conflict. UCDP recorded 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Al Shabaab detonerte en IED i Mandera, og seks sivile ble skadet, og Røde Kors behandlede 148 sårede etter tung kamp i Baidoa. Etiopia kunngjorde at mer enn 3 000 soldater trekkes tilbake fra Somalia ettersom egen borgerkrig intensiveres, og har nektet å intervenere i konflikten i South West State. approved.en: Ebola has expanded to an eighth province in the DRC, prompting heightened alerts in Lubumbashi and calls for border closures. Kenyan and other long-distance truck drivers suspended DRC-bound cargo after 12 drivers were killed, leading Kenya to halt operations and Uganda to close its border over Ebola fears. Rebel groups including the FRN near Lubumbashi and the ADF in Ituri continued attacks that killed civilians and threatened regional security. The African Union is urging cease-fire compliance and inclusive dialogue. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.nb: Maduro står igjen overfor en amerikansk tiltale som påberoper en sjelden brukt torturlov for å ha beordret tortur av rivaler, mens USA har opphevet sanksjoner mot lederen for nasjonalforsamlingen og satt i drift elektromagnetiske og elektroniske krigssystemer fra Space Force mot Venezuela. Trump-administrasjonen planlegger endringer i Delcy Rodríguez' regjering og oljesektoren, og en nederlandsk sikkerhetsrapport advarer om at Venezuelas ustabilitet kan true Curaçao og det bredere Karibiske kongeriket. Opposisjonsgrupper mobiliserer landsomfattende protester som krever valg og tilbakekalling av Machado, og arbeidere presser regjeringen for reell lønnsgjenoppretting. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2007, ifølge UCDP.
